subject: POC Bridge: access sprint — API keys, org onboarding, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Bridge: access sprint — API keys, org onboarding, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our agreement, I’ve sketched a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the POC environment items we discussed so we can align on owners and close dates. High-level goal: get HealthSync a production-like test tenant with API access and networking in place so your team can run the evaluation workload by the week of 6/19.

Proposed POC milestones (short):
- Org onboarding: create org + seats (owner: HealthSync admin) — target 6/1
- API keys: issue evaluation API keys, scoped to test org — target 6/3
- IP allowlist: exchange public IPs, apply allowlist — target 6/7
- VPC peering (optional): schedule peering & initial verification — target 6/14

Attached: POC_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP with responsibilities), network-allowlist-template.csv (for your infra team), redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (technical steps).

Can you confirm: 1) that the targets above are feasible for HealthSync, and 2) who will be the internal contact for peering (if you want peering enabled)? If peering is a no-go, we’ll proceed with API keys + allowlist only.

If that looks good I’ll add these items to the HubSpot opportunity and schedule a 30-min tech sync next week to walk the allowlist and peering plan.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthsync.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@healthsync.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Bridge: access sprint — API keys, org onboarding, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Dylan —

Thanks, this is really helpful. Quick notes from our side:
- Org onboarding: we can create the org and confirm two admin users by 6/2. Alyssa will own.
- API keys: legal wants to confirm data handling — can you send the minimal data flow diagram and whether logs include PII?
- IP allowlist: networking prefers allowlist over peering initially. They asked for the CSV template (you attached one).
- VPC peering: our infra is open to peering but needs a 2-week lead time; they asked for an exact maintenance window and the CIDR ranges to avoid overlap.

Question: if peering slips beyond 6/14, does Redwood allow a temporary elevated-rate API key for bulk ingestion so we can complete the eval without peering?

I can confirm Alyssa Nguyen (cc) will be the technical contact for onboarding and allowlist.

Best,
Sam
Head of Platform
HealthSync
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: POC Bridge: access sprint — API keys, org onboarding, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Forwarding Sam's reply below. Suggested internal plan to keep timeline:

- Action 1 (Dylan/Ben): Prepare minimal data flow + logs note for legal (deliverable: data-flow-onepager.pdf) — due 6/2. Owner: Ben.
- Action 2 (Neha): Pre-create evaluation org and stub users in console so HealthSync can accept invite — due 6/2. Owner: Neha.
- Action 3 (Dylan): Issue scoped API keys (rate-limited) and optional elevated-rate ingest keys if peering delayed — due 6/3. Owner: Dylan.
- Action 4 (Ben/Infra): Validate allowlist apply process and send network-allowlist-template.csv to HealthSync (confirm NAT/public IPs) — due 6/5. Owner: Ben.
- Action 5 (Jordan): Draft peering runbook & suggested window; include CIDR guidance — due 6/9. Owner: Jordan Blake.

Notes:
- If peering is not in place by 6/14, we'll issue a temporary elevated-rate key for a 48-hour bulk ingest window (controlled, monitored) — this addresses Sam's question.
- I attached the network template and redwood-poc-checklist for quick reference.

Can we block a 30-min tech call for Wed 6/6 11:00am PT? I’ll include Jordan for peering specifics.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@healthsync.com>, Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC Bridge: access sprint — API keys, org onboarding, IP allowlist, VPC peering

Sam / Alyssa —

Thanks for the quick responses and for lining up your infra team. Per the calls and the MAP workbook, confirming the agreed close path and who does what. Summary and firmed dates: 

1) Org onboarding — HealthSync to create org and confirm two admin users. Completed 6/2 (Alyssa).
2) Data flow & logs — Ben attached a one-pager to the HubSpot deal and sent to your legal (Ben, please confirm). Delivered 6/2.
3) API keys — issued scoped eval keys for the test org on 6/3. Keys are rate limited to protect production. If peering not complete by 6/14 we will enable a temporary elevated ingest key for a 48-hour window (requested / audited).
4) IP allowlist — received HealthSync public IPs on 6/5; allowlist applied in staging on 6/6. Please confirm connectivity from your side.
5) VPC peering — Jordan to run peering with your infra. Proposed peering window: 6/14 02:00–06:00 PT, verification 6/15. Jordan will send the runbook and CIDRs by 6/9.

Next steps (concrete):
- Ben: confirm legal acknowledged the data flow and whether any additional docs are required (Ben to reply by EOD 6/13).
- Alyssa: confirm connectivity test results after allowlist (please send traceroute / curl sample) — target 6/8.
- Jordan: send peering runbook + signoff checklist by 6/9.
- Dylan: I’ll update HS-4381 in HubSpot with the MAP milestones and lock the canary rollout settings for your org.

If HealthSync is ready to move to a canary run after connectivity checks we’ll start the evaluation workload immediately and aim for a close conversation the week of 6/19. If you want a brief legal/ops call to finalize peering SOW language, Ben and I can join.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the test run.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC_MAP_v1.xlsx (in HubSpot deal), network-allowlist-template.csv, redwood-poc-checklist.pdf
